generation_recipes_scope: Includes historical generation studies and the current pinned master records. Current source selection is established by the producing manifest and its exact SHA256 pins; historical records are unchanged.
limitations: The broad relief repeats after568x320world pixels; whole-map variation and readability remain open.
Hill/grass summer only; other-ground transitions, fractional zoom, native mapping, units/UI and runtime/release acceptance remain open.
Isolated-only compact low hill cue restores flat global phases; connected terrain uses the continuous global field without per-cell stamps.

original_image_inputs.role: Semantic original reference only: Only image input: composition, muted olive palette and low-frequency restoration reference; original file remains reference-only.

original_image_inputs_scope: Semantic visual references used to paint the current masters or their fixture ground. Originals remain reference-only and are not bundled as runtime PNGs; source masters are newly painted. Unit sprite planes retain their existing independent artwork provenance.
ownership: Final pixel centers use polygon (25,0),(71,0),(96,40),(71,80),(25,80),(0,40). Complementary top-left half-open ownership: cross(edge,point)>0; edge ties include dy<0 or dy==0 && dx>0. Owned alpha 255; outside zero RGBA. Crop/filter before this final mask.
profile:
hills-v1: bounded summer hills/grass exporter; context keys are full lowercase SHA256 of hills-v1
season=summer
center=<id>
phase=<x>,<y>
NE=<id>
SE=<id>
S=<id>
SW=<id>
NW=<id>
N=<id>
 with literal LF after every line. Normalize actual integer lattice origins modulo (568,320); grass normalizes phase and neighbors. Global height-derived relief normal with slope attenuation near grass: scalar H=32*Rec709(bilinear source at cosine world coordinates)/255, offsets (113,79), periods (568,320), central derivative h=2. Product of per-grass filled-polygon distance quintic gates on [7,19] attenuates slopes AFTER differentiation; no derivative of the grass gate. Only isolated hills (all six grass neighbors) add a compact rotated cubic ellipse height cue before differentiation, centered (48,40), radii (28,22); phase-derived angle and amplitude fade against nine-sample unattenuated global shade RMS. Connected and mixed hill contexts have no cue. Fixed world light (-.55,-.4,.75), ambient .35/diffuse .65, flat-normal normalization, shade clamp [.55,1.25]; unchanged grass sampling and half-up RGB rounding. No authored height bytes change or per-pixel art rotation. Whole opaque 416x352 4x overscan -> whole unmasked Lanczos3 208x176 2x -> crop four world pixels -> independent complementary half-open ownership; no pre-mask. Final four-world-pixel grass quiet band is byte exact; maximum filter displacement 1.375 per axis (1.944543648 radial), 4+1.944543648<7. Omitted grass polygons have distance >=42 on P expanded by four, greater than 19; global gradient is independent of context. Isolated cue radius+derivative reach+filter support <=28+2+1.944543648<40, so it cannot reach another cell's owned filter domain. No global C2 claim: polygon distance and bilinear luminance have their own regularity. Export all64 phase0 masks, all32 isolated phases and actual fixed eight fixture contexts; other phases/masks and arbitrary-map runtime selection remain OPEN.
